cnTitle: 命宫怎么看：一张盘的总开关，先定底色再看全局
enTitle: How to Read the Life Palace: The Master Switch of a Zi Wei Chart
enDesc: The Life Palace holds your innate temperament, baseline behavior and main life axis, yet it is not the whole chart. Read its major star first, then open the triple-direction, Body Palace and transformations.
cnDesc: 命宫写的是先天性格、行为底色与人生主轴，但它不是整张盘的全部；先认命宫主星，再拉三方四正、身宫与四化，底色才看得准。

cnTitle: 夫妻宫怎么看：感情的相处模式，看的是关系不是童话
enTitle: How to Read the Spouse Palace: It Describes a Relationship, Not a Fairy Tale
enDesc: The Spouse Palace describes how you behave in close relationships and the type you tend to attract, not only who the other person is. Read it with the triple-direction, the opposite Career Palace and romance or malefic stars.
cnDesc: 夫妻宫写的是你在亲密关系里的相处模式与容易吸引的类型，不是只用来描述「对方是什么人」；合三方、对宫官禄与桃花煞星，关系质量才看得清。

cnTitle: 子女宫怎么看：孩子、缘分与创造，看的是相处不是讨债
enTitle: How to Read the Children Palace: Children, Bonds and Creativity, Not Debt
enDesc: The Children Palace describes your bond and relating with children and juniors, and it also governs creativity and the fruits of cooperation. Do not use it only to count children or read friction as someone coming to collect a debt.
cnDesc: 子女宫写你和子女、晚辈的缘分与相处，也主创造力和合作的成果；别只拿它数孩子数量，更别把波折看成谁来讨债。

cnTitle: 财帛宫怎么看：赚钱方式与金钱观，看的是来路不是存款数
enTitle: How to Read the Wealth Palace: How You Earn, Not the Size of Your Savings
enDesc: The Wealth Palace describes how you pursue money, your income sources and your attitude toward money, not your account balance. Read it with Career, Property and the opposite Karma Palace, plus transformations, to see whether money stays.
cnDesc: 财帛宫写的是你的求财方式、收入来源和金钱观，不是存款数字；合官禄、田宅与对宫福德，再看四化飞化，钱能不能留住才清楚。

cnTitle: 迁移宫怎么看：外出、远方与世界，看的是际遇不是奔波
enTitle: How to Read the Travel Palace: Encounters Out in the World, Not Mere Busyness
enDesc: The Travel Palace describes how you behave and what you encounter in the wider world, far from home and among strangers, and it also governs your public stage and outside ties. Do not equate travel with bad or stillness with security; read it with the opposite Life Palace.
cnDesc: 迁移宫写你在外部世界、远方和陌生人面前的状态与际遇，也主社会舞台和外缘；别把奔波多就当坏、闲就当稳，要合对宫命宫一起看。

cnTitle: 官禄宫怎么看：事业方向与成就感，看的是赛道不是头衔
enTitle: How to Read the Career Palace: Direction and Fulfillment, Not Job Titles
enDesc: The Career Palace describes the professional track that suits you, your work style and the source of fulfillment, not the height of a title. Read it with Wealth, the opposite Spouse Palace and transformations for the full picture.
cnDesc: 官禄宫写你适合的事业赛道、工作姿态与成就感来源，不是头衔高低；合财帛、对宫夫妻与四化，事业这条路才看得完整。

cnTitle: 田宅宫怎么看：家庭、不动产与归属，看的是库藏不是房子大小
enTitle: How to Read the Property Palace: Home, Property and Belonging, Not the Size of the House
enDesc: The Property Palace describes the atmosphere at home, your bond with real estate and a sense of belonging, and it is also where money is stored. Do not read it only as house size; combine the opposite Children Palace, Wealth and transformations to see whether money settles.
cnDesc: 田宅宫写家庭氛围、不动产缘分和归属感，也是钱财的库藏；别只拿它看房子大小，要合对宫子女、财帛与四化，财能不能沉淀才清楚。

cnTitle: 父母宫怎么看：长辈、文书与根基，看的是缘分不是亏欠
enTitle: How to Read the Parents Palace: Elders, Documents and Roots, Not Debt
enDesc: The Parents Palace describes your bond and relating with parents, elders and teachers, and it also governs documents, education, contracts and protection. Do not read friction as a destined debt; combine the opposite Health Palace and trines.
cnDesc: 父母宫写你和父母、长辈、师长的缘分与相处，也主文书、学历、契约和庇护；别把波折看成注定的亏欠，要合对宫疾厄与三方一起读。

cnTitle: 禄权同宫：有资源也有话语权，怎么把强势用成成事
enTitle: When Hua Lu and Hua Quan Share a Palace: Resources and Authority Together
enDesc: Hua Lu brings resources and opportunity while Hua Quan brings control and execution. Together they mean you both secure the backing and call the shots, which favors business, leadership and autonomy; the risk is being forceful and transactional and provoking envy.
cnDesc: 化禄主资源机缘，化权主掌控执行，同宫等于既拿得到本钱又说了算，利经营、带队与自主；短板是强势功利、对人不留情面，容易招嫉。

cnTitle: 禄科同宫：财气配名声，怎么把人缘用成长久贵人
enTitle: When Hua Lu and Hua Ke Share a Palace: Means and Reputation Together
enDesc: Hua Lu brings real benefit and opportunity while Hua Ke brings reputation and smoothing. Together means means and name reinforce each other, with strong relationships and mentors, which favors education, expertise and reputation-driven work; the risk is prizing face and being led by obligations.
cnDesc: 化禄主实利机缘，化科主名声缓和，同宫等于财气和名气互相带动，人缘好、贵人多，利教育、专业与口碑型发展；短板是好面子、易被人情牵住。

cnTitle: 权科同宫：实干又有名，怎么把说服力用成专业招牌
enTitle: When Hua Quan and Hua Ke Share a Palace: Doing the Work and Being Known
enDesc: Hua Quan brings execution and control while Hua Ke brings reputation and reason. Together means you both deliver and persuade, which favors professional recognition, technical tracks and leadership; the risk is competitiveness, face and refusing dissent.
cnDesc: 化权主执行掌控，化科主名声理性，同宫等于既做得出又说得服，利专业成名、技术路线与带队；短板是好胜、爱面子、听不进异见。

cnTitle: 自化科怎么看：名声自己往外亮，也要防虚名好面子
enTitle: How to Read the Self-Transforming Hua Ke: Reputation You Project Yourself
enDesc: When a palace stem makes its own star transform to Ke, you actively project image and reputation, which favors exams, publishing and public relations. Unlike a natal Ke that is innate, guard against an empty name, prizing face and flowering without fruit.
cnDesc: 宫干使本宫星自化科，是自己主动把形象、名声往外亮，利考试、发表与公关；与生年科的「天生有名」不同，要防虚名、好面子、苗而不秀。

cnTitle: 怎么找格局的破格点：再好的格，也要看哪里被冲破
enTitle: How to Find Where a Pattern Is Broken in a Zi Wei Chart
enDesc: A pattern is a net combination of stars, and its breaking point is the one or two malefics, Ji, emptiness or clashes that disrupt the structure. Check in the order of home palace, trines, opposite and flanking palaces to distinguish a valid pattern with flaws from one that exists in name only.
cnDesc: 格局是星曜的净组合，破格点就是破坏结构的那一两个煞、忌、空、劫；按本宫、三方、对宫、夹宫顺序排查，分清「成格有瑕」与「名存实破」。

cnTitle: 大限盘怎么重布十二宫：以大限命宫立太极的看法
enTitle: How to Rebuild the Twelve Palaces on the Decade Chart
enDesc: When you enter a decade, use its Life Palace as the new origin and rebuild the twelve palaces in direction for those ten years, then add the decade transformations. Palaces are relationships, not place names; this is the ten-year lens, layered separately from the annual chart.
cnDesc: 进入某个大限，要以大限命宫为新原点，按方向重排这十年的十二宫，再配大限四化；宫位是关系不是地名，这套是「十年视角」，与流年盘分层。

cnTitle: 飞星怎么追禄忌路线：把宫位之间的因果一笔笔连起来
enTitle: How to Trace the Lu and Ji Routes: Linking Cause and Effect Across Palaces
enDesc: Palace-stem flying transformations link the twelve palaces into a network; Lu is the cause and investment, Ji the result and attachment. Use Lu-turns-to-Ji to trace where the return lands or stalls, setting the Tai Ji first, distinct from static natal transformations.
cnDesc: 宫干飞化把十二宫连成网络，禄为因、为投入，忌为果、为牵挂；用「禄转忌」追一件事的回报落在哪、卡在哪，先立太极再追，区别于静态生年四化。

cnTitle: 四化象义怎么对应到具体人事：禄权科忌落到生活场景
enTitle: How to Map the Four Transformations to Real Life Situations
enDesc: The Four Transformations are changes in how a star expresses itself, not fixed good or bad scores. Lu is opportunity and resources, Quan control and responsibility, Ke reputation and documents, Ji attachment and debt. Combine the star and palace to translate the terms into real situations.
cnDesc: 四化是星曜表达方式的变化，不是固定吉凶分数；禄主机会资源、权主掌控责任、科主名声文书、忌主执着亏欠，结合落星落宫，才能把术语翻译成现实场景。

cnTitle: 科权禄夹命怎么看：三吉夹命与三奇嘉会的区别
enTitle: How to Read Ke Quan Lu Flanking the Life Palace
enDesc: When Hua Lu, Hua Quan and Hua Ke sit in the two palaces flanking the Life Palace, outside support surrounds you with reputation and resources on both sides. Its geometry differs from the Three Wonders meeting in the trine; it is rarer and must be checked for malefics or Ji breaking it.
cnDesc: 化禄、化权、化科分布在命宫前后两夹宫，主外部助力环伺、名声与资源左右逢源；它与三奇嘉会（三方会）几何结构不同，更少见，须核无煞忌冲破。

cnTitle: 日出扶桑格怎么看：太阳在卯守命的清贵稳步
enTitle: How to Read the Sun Rising at Fusang Pattern
enDesc: When the Sun star guards the Life Palace in the Mao palace, it is like the rising sun, bringing clean distinction, steady progress and self-made beginnings. It still needs auspicious transformations and trine support; malefics discount it, and brightness only sets the starting point.
cnDesc: 太阳在卯宫守命，如旭日初升，主清贵、稳步、靠自己起家；仍要吉化与三方配合，逢煞星减分，庙旺得地只给起点，兑现看四化与努力。

cnTitle: 水澄桂萼格怎么看：天同太阴在子守命的温和有主张
enTitle: How to Read the Clear Water Reflecting Laurel Pattern
enDesc: When Tian Tong and Tai Yin guard the Life Palace in the Zi palace, it is like clear water reflecting the moon, bringing gentleness with conviction and a blend of blessing and wealth. It is steadier for those born at night; guard drifting and laziness, and auspicious transformations are still needed.
cnDesc: 天同太阴在子宫守命，如清水映明月，主温和有主张、福财交并；夜生人更稳，防飘荡与懒散，仍要吉化配合，庙旺只给底子。

cnTitle: 金灿光辉格怎么看：太阳在辰巳守命的外放功名
enTitle: How to Read the Golden Radiance Pattern
enDesc: When the Sun star guards the Life Palace in the Chen or Si palace, its light grows stronger, bringing outward expression, achievement and many mentors. Guard being too rigid, overworking and showing too much edge; brightness gives visibility, but results still need transformations and real accumulation.
cnDesc: 太阳在辰、巳宫守命，光芒渐盛，主外放、功名、贵人多；防过刚、操劳与锋芒太露，庙旺给能见度，兑现仍看四化与现实积累。

cnTitle: 十四主星沟通方式对照：不同星把同一件事说成不同样子
enTitle: How the Fourteen Major Stars Communicate: A Comparison
enDesc: For the same matter, Qi Sha speaks directly, Tian Ji circles, Zi Wei minds face, Tian Tong seeks harmony and Tai Yin withdraws. Understanding your own and the other star script helps you connect and reduce misunderstanding, without ranking who is better.
cnDesc: 同样一件事，七杀直说、天机绕弯、紫微要面子、天同求和、太阴回避；看懂自己和对方的星性脚本，才能对上话、少误会，不是定谁好谁坏。

cnTitle: 十四主星压力应对对照：承压时有人硬扛、有人内耗、有人回避
enTitle: How the Fourteen Major Stars Handle Pressure: A Comparison
enDesc: Under pressure, Wu Qu and Qi Sha tough it out, Tian Ji and Tai Yin turn inward, Tian Tong and Tian Liang withdraw, Zi Wei and Tan Lang strive to win. Knowing your own pressure script helps you choose the right response and tells those around you how to support you.
cnDesc: 压力来时，武曲七杀硬扛、天机太阴内耗、天同天梁回避、紫微贪狼求胜；看懂自己的承压脚本，才能选对解法，身边人也知道怎么配合。

cnTitle: 十四主星合伙搭档对照：先看分工再谈感情，哪些互补哪些硬碰
enTitle: How the Fourteen Major Stars Partner: Complement vs. Collision
enDesc: Partnership is not about finding friends but about dividing roles: resource types pair with execution types, principle types with coordinating types. Two control-heavy stars (Zi Wei, Wu Qu, Qi Sha) collide and easily split; write out authority and responsibility before discussing feelings.
cnDesc: 合伙不是找朋友，是找分工：资源型配执行型、原则型配协调型；两个都要掌控的星（紫微、武曲、七杀）硬碰容易散，先把权责写清再谈情分。

cnTitle: 十四主星学习方式对照：顺着星性选方法，比硬逼自己更高效
enTitle: How the Fourteen Major Stars Learn Best: Follow Your Star Nature
enDesc: Tian Ji suits deep reasoning, Tan Lang suits broad exposure, Wu Qu suits hands-on practice, Tian Tong suits visuals and atmosphere, Zi Wei suits systematic frameworks. Choosing a method that fits your star nature is far more efficient than forcing one method on everyone.
cnDesc: 天机适合钻研推理、贪狼适合多门涉猎、武曲适合实操上手、天同适合图像和氛围、紫微适合系统框架；顺着星性选学法，效率远高于硬逼自己用同一种方式。

cnTitle: 流年走禄存怎么看：财星当值的一年，利稳财守成
enTitle: How to Read the Annual Chart Passing Through Lu Cun
enDesc: When the annual Life Palace passes through Lu Cun, the wealth star is on duty, favoring steady income, saving and preservation. But it is not the same for everyone; still read the natal Wealth Palace and triple-direction, as Lu Cun with emptiness or robbery can mean seeing it but not holding it.
cnDesc: 流年命宫走到禄存，财星当值，利稳财、储蓄、守成；但不是人人一样，仍要看本命财帛与三方四正，禄存逢空劫也可能是「看着有、抓不住」。

cnTitle: 流年走天马怎么看：奔忙多动的一年，把奔波变成机会
enTitle: How to Read the Annual Chart Passing Through Tian Ma
enDesc: When the annual Life Palace passes through Tian Ma, it brings busyness, movement and favors travel and change. Whether the running becomes opportunity depends on the natal Travel Palace and trine; with Lu it generates wealth through movement, so guard against empty busyness, exhaustion and running back and forth.
cnDesc: 流年命宫走到天马，主奔忙、多动、利外出与变化；把奔波变成机会要看本命迁移与三方，逢禄则动中生财，防空忙、劳损与两头跑。

cnTitle: 害太岁怎么看：2026丑午相害，主人际暗耗与口舌误会
enTitle: How to Read Harming the Tai Sui in 2026
enDesc: In 2026 Bing Wu, the Chou ox and Wu horse harm each other, bringing hidden interpersonal drain, verbal misunderstanding and cooperation friction. Harming Tai Sui is a reminder, not a destined disaster; speak openly, keep written contracts and avoid key decisions in unfavorable months.
cnDesc: 2026丙午年，丑牛与午马相害，主人际暗耗、口舌误会、合作不顺；害太岁是提醒不是定灾，把话说开、守住书面契约、关键决策避不利月份即可。

cnTitle: 刑太岁怎么看：2026午午自刑，主自我折磨与内耗
enTitle: How to Read Punishing the Tai Sui in 2026
enDesc: In 2026 Bing Wu, the Wu horse self-punishes (Wu-Wu punishment), bringing self-torment, inner friction and overthinking. Punishing Tai Sui is mostly fighting oneself; learning to address issues not oneself, keeping regular routines and asking for help works better than seeking external solutions.
cnDesc: 2026丙午年，午马自刑（午午相刑），主自我折磨、内耗、钻牛角尖；刑太岁多是自己跟自己过不去，学会对事不对自己、规律作息、肯求助，比外求更有效。

cnTitle: 怎么用命盘识别破财信号与现实防骗清单
enTitle: How to Spot Wealth-Loss Signals in a Chart and Prevent Fraud
enDesc: In a chart, Hua Ji, emptiness, robbery or waste stars aspecting the Wealth or Karma Palace signal a tendency toward wealth loss. But fraud prevention ultimately relies on real actions: do not click unknown links, do not transfer money, verify official channels, and any paid luck-changing, treasury-replenishing or consecrated wealth-blessing is likely a scam.
cnDesc: 命盘中化忌、空劫、大耗会照财帛或福德，是破财的倾向信号；但防骗最终靠现实动作：不点陌生链接、不转账、核验官方渠道，凡「花钱改运、补财库、开光招财」多为骗局。

cnTitle: 兼职第二收入怎么看：用主业稳盘、用兼职试水，防本末倒置
enTitle: How to Approach Side Jobs and Second Income
enDesc: A side job uses the main career to stabilize the base and spare energy to test a second curve. Read the Career and Wealth Palaces in the chart for whether time and energy suffice and whether the trine supports it, guarding against the side job crowding out the main career and taking on too much.
cnDesc: 兼职是用主业稳基本盘、用多余精力试水第二曲线；命盘看官禄与财帛的配合，时间精力够不够、三方有没有支撑，防兼职挤垮主业、贪多嚼不烂。

cnTitle: 职场站队怎么看：守住专业与边界，比依附派系更稳
enTitle: How to Handle Workplace Faction Alignment
enDesc: Workplace factions are a reality of power structures; read the Career and Friends Palaces in the chart. But in the long run, guarding professional competence and boundaries, not easily taking sides and protecting yourself through documentation and process is steadier than attaching to one faction.
cnDesc: 职场派系是权力结构的现实，命盘看官禄与交友的配合；但长期来看，守住专业能力和职业边界、不轻易选边、以书面与流程保护自己，比依附某一派更稳。

cnTitle: 债务上岸怎么看：定节奏、做减法、先高息后低息
enTitle: How to Get Out of Debt: A Practical Path
enDesc: Getting out of debt does not depend on chart luck-turning but on a real financial plan: inventory all debts, set a repayment rhythm, cut expenses, pay high-interest before low-interest, and communicate with creditors through proper written channels. The chart only hints at which stage tends to incur debt and why.
cnDesc: 债务上岸不靠命盘转运，靠的是现实的财务计划：盘点全部负债、定还款节奏、做支出减法、先还高息后还低息，与债权人沟通走正规书面途径，命盘只提示哪个阶段容易因什么负债。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数是不是迷信：传统符号体系，知命而不宿命
enTitle: Is Zi Wei Dou Shu Superstition? A Traditional Symbol System
enDesc: Zi Wei Dou Shu is a model of heaven-human correspondence built by the ancients using star imagery, belonging to traditional symbolism and humanistic observation, not a falsifiable scientific conclusion. Its value lies in self-understanding and decision support; one should know fate without being fatalistic, using it for reflection rather than letting it decide for you.
cnDesc: 紫微斗数是古人用星象建立的天人对应模型，属传统符号与人文观察体系，不是可证伪的科学结论；它的价值在认识自我、辅助决策，应「知命而不宿命」，用它反思而不是用它替你做决定。

cnTitle: 什么是四化：禄权科忌是命盘的能量开关
enTitle: What Are the Four Transformations? The Energy Switches of a Chart
enDesc: The Four Transformations are changes in how stars express themselves: Hua Lu governs resources and opportunity, Hua Quan control and execution, Hua Ke reputation and smoothing, Hua Ji attachment and debt. They are not fixed good-or-bad scores but the energy switches of a chart; understand the meanings first, then discuss which palace they land in.
cnDesc: 四化是星曜表达方式的变化：化禄主资源机缘、化权主掌控执行、化科主名声缓和、化忌主执着亏欠；它们不是固定吉凶分数，而是命盘的能量开关，先懂象义再谈落宫。

cnTitle: 同一时辰出生的人命运一样吗：盘给趋势，选择分高下
enTitle: Do People Born in the Same Shichen Share the Same Fate?
enDesc: People born in the same shichen (two-hour window) produce similar chart structures, but their fates are not the same. The chart gives shared tendencies and probability ranges; environment, family, effort and key choices separate outcomes. Time is infinitely divisible, so shichen-based reading has inherent limitations.
cnDesc: 同一时辰出生的人排出来的盘结构相似，但命运不会一样；盘给的是共同趋势与概率区间，环境、家庭、努力、关键选择分高下，时间无限可分，时辰论命有先天局限。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数能看风水吗：斗数看人事时间，风水看空间，各有体系
enTitle: Can Zi Wei Dou Shu Read Feng Shui? Two Separate Systems
enDesc: Zi Wei Dou Shu reads human affairs and timing, while feng shui (Kan Yu) reads spatial environment and energy flow; they are different systems. The Property Palace in Zi Wei can reflect living conditions and family atmosphere, but it cannot replace a professional feng shui survey, and the two should not be conflated.
cnDesc: 紫微斗数看的是人事与时间节奏，风水（堪舆）看的是空间环境与气场，二者是不同体系；斗数里的田宅宫可以反映居住状态和家庭氛围，但不能替代专业风水勘察，不宜混为一谈。

cnTitle: 手术择期怎么看：命理只是倾向参考，一切以正规医院为准
enTitle: How to Approach Scheduling Surgery
enDesc: A chart can hint at the timing and tendency of health thresholds, but surgery scheduling must follow the judgment of proper hospitals and professional doctors. Do not delay necessary treatment for astrology; scheduling only means choosing a relatively stable time within what the doctor allows.
cnDesc: 命盘可以提示健康关口的时间节奏和倾向，但手术安排必须以正规医院和专业医生的判断为准；不因命理拖延必要治疗，择期只是在医生允许的范围内选相对平稳的时间。

cnTitle: 提前还贷怎么看：权衡现金流与利率，留足应急钱
enTitle: How to Decide Whether to Pay Off a Loan Early
enDesc: Paying off a loan early is not the earlier the better; one must weigh the loan interest rate, investment return, cash-flow safety and emergency reserve. The Wealth and Property Palaces can hint at financial rhythm, but the final decision follows the formal loan contract and licensed institution guidance; this is not investment advice.
cnDesc: 提前还贷不是「越早还越好」，要权衡贷款利率、投资收益率、现金流安全和应急储备；命盘财帛与田宅可提示财务节奏，但最终决策以正规贷款合同和持牌机构说明为准，不构成投资建议。

cnTitle: 三合宫配对怎么看：本宫与两个三合宫是核心—资源—执行
enTitle: How to Read Trine Palace Pairings: Core, Resource, Execution
enDesc: The trine is not a queue; the home palace and its two trine palaces form an echo of core, resource and execution. Reading the trine means pairing by theme: for example, the Wealth Palace trines with Career and Karma, governing how you earn and how spending feels, and only all three together give the full picture.
cnDesc: 三合不是排队，本宫与两个三合宫构成「核心—资源—执行」的呼应；看三合要配对看主题词，比如财帛的三合是官禄和福德，分别管赚钱的方式和花钱的感受，三者连起来才读得全。

cnTitle: 星曜分阴阳怎么理解：冷热、动静、表里的底层钥匙
enTitle: How to Understand Stars Divided by Yin and Yang
enDesc: Stars have yin and yang, which determines their expression of cold-heat, movement-stillness and inner-outer: yang stars lean outward, active and warm, yin stars lean inward, passive and cool. Yin-yang is the underlying key to understanding star nature; the same star with different yin-yang expresses differently by palace.
cnDesc: 星有阴阳，决定冷热、动静、表里的表达方式：阳星偏外放、主动、热，阴星偏内敛、被动、冷；阴阳是理解星性的底层钥匙，同颗星阴阳不同，落宫表现也不同。
